fields.description: Prefixes every model id this provider serves (openai/gpt-5), so it is set once. The vendors pathway knows (its vendor.known) and frappe for our own engines: a gateway refuses a push naming any other, so a new vendor ships in pathway first. One record per Geography shares the name: the id stays the same everywhere and each gateway dials its own geography's record.
fields.label: Provider Name
fields.options:
anthropic
baseten
deepseek
frappe
morph
openai

fields.description: What a customer's dashboard shows for the provider (OpenAI). The name's, not this record's: a save writes it on every record of the name, and a new record takes it. Blank shows the name.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: The provider our own engines serve under: a Model with no provider is named here, and only its models can be deployed. Exactly one, and it dials nothing — a URL is what makes a vendor.
fields.label: Self Hosted

fields.description: The provider keeps nothing of a request once it is answered. Always on for the Self Hosted provider: our engines store nothing. Teams see it beside each model in their dashboard.
fields.label: Zero Data Retention

fields.description: Where this vendor account processes requests. Only gateways in this geography dial this record, so a regional front (eu.api.openai.com) is a second record under the same Provider Name. Blank for our own engines, which take their geography from wherever they run.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Headers the gateway adds to every request it makes to this record's fronts (anthropic-beta). The credential and the version header are the gateway's own and win over these.
fields.label: Extra Headers

fields.description: How a gateway picks the key for a request: each in turn, in table order, one cursor per vendor across all its models. Whatever is picked, a key answering 429 is swapped for the next once, and one answering 401/402/403 is skipped for the rest of that request.
fields.label: Key Selection
